image_description: A close-up, high-contrast image of a cooked Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) against a dark background. The crab is positioned ventral-side up or tilted, revealing the underside of the carapace and legs. The shell exhibits characteristic reddish-orange coloration on the limbs and claws, transitioning to creamy white on the ventral side. The large chelipeds (claws) are prominent, with dark tips visible on the upper claw. The texture appears glossy and hard, consistent with a cooked crustacean exoskeleton.
